reference.question: \(AD\) is an angle bisector of \(\triangle ABC\). Given \(\angle BAD=25^\circ\), how many degrees is \(\angle BAC\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Double one of the equal angles

\(AD\) bisects \(\angle BAC\), so \(\angle BAC=2\angle BAD=50^\circ\).
